---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for AgriShield
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / Motivation

A clear description of the problem this feature would solve, or the opportunity it would create for farmers, investors, or operators.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like to see implemented. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why you prefer your proposal.

## Component

Which part of the system would this affect?

- [ ] Smart Contracts (Soroban / Rust)
- [ ] Oracle Service (Node.js)
- [ ] Frontend (React / TypeScript)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI / DevOps

## Impact

Who benefits from this feature and how?

- [ ] Farmers (coverage, payouts, enrollment)
- [ ] Investors (liquidity management, returns)
- [ ] Oracle operators
- [ ] Developers / contributors
- [ ] All users

## Additional Context

Any mockups, references, links to similar implementations, or other context.
